referenceSources.description:
A striking red 1984 Autobianchi A112 Series 6 Abarth is showcased with authentic rally decals from Motul, Total, Michelin, and Chardonnet. The compact hatchback sits on black alloy wheels and features additional front spotlights, a black leather interior with bucket seats, and USB connectivity. Visible branding includes Sabelt, Akrapovic, Brembo, and Bilstein, highlighting its performance pedigree.

This classic A112 has been fully restored and driven only 1,500 km. Under the hood, a 70 hp engine with a Weber 30 carburetor and reinforced running gear ensures spirited driving. Located in St Vincent de Tyrosse, France, the car comes with optional concierge services, transport logistics, and a comprehensive independent inspection for prospective buyers.
